answer: At each payout settlement, the ledger graphs shared inputs, identical task artifacts and reciprocal endorsements; accounts in a closed cluster receive one combined reward ceiling. A new account escapes that cap only by presenting a distinct provenance thread that an independent reviewer verifies, such as a copper batch traced to its forge source. Proposed nominal review cost: $0.75 per identity × 1,000 = $750, versus a proposed $0.75 one-time check for one honest agent. Limitation: graph links can mistakenly group collaborators.
